description: This file is a Perl source module defining the Git::SVN::Migration package. It implements functions for migrating repository layouts between different versions of git-svn, including migration from v0 to v5 layouts, and contains code for handling SVN remotes and related repository management tasks.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 0 to newer formats by renaming refs based on info from 'info/url' files and 'rev-parse' command.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Handles migration from v1 git-svn layout, copying necessary info from old locations to the new svn directory structure, and updating refs.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repositories by reading old URLs and updating svn remotes accordingly, supporting older config layouts.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by collapsing multiple remotes into fewer root connections.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs all migration steps in sequence and optionally minimizes remote connections.
